purpose: Teach: 一つ一つ/思いつい/ホラー/満点/秘訣/フィット/ネクタイ/香水

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、ブロック、絶対、一つ一つ、絶対、組み立てたよ
lines.en: Mom, I really, really built every single block myself, I promise.
lines.style: Bright, urgent delivery. Breathless with pride and the need to be believed. Quick pace on the list of blocks. Slight lift at the end — seeking approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、本気で、絶対、新企画、絶対、思いついた、絶対、らしいわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad apparently came up with some totally new idea at work.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Soft smile in the voice. Casual observation shared the way parents talk to their kids — noticing life out loud. Gentle pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お友達が、本気で、絶対、ホラー、絶対、ゲーム、絶対、見せてくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, my friend showed me this really scary horror game the other day.
lines.style: Excited whisper, conspiratorial. Eyes wide. Quick words tumbling over each other. The thrill of having seen something grown-up. Small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、テストで、絶対、満点、絶対、目指してね
lines.en: Sho, I want you to really aim for a perfect score on your test, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but clear intention. Not commanding — inviting him to try. Steady, quiet confidence. The tone of someone who believes he can do it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、勉強の、絶対、秘訣、絶対、教えて
lines.en: Mom, will you teach me the secret to studying hard?
lines.style: Sincere request, not joking. Quiet earnestness. The voice of a small child who has noticed his mother knows things and trusts her completely.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、新しい靴、絶対、フィット、絶対、してる?本気で
lines.en: Sho, are your new shoes fitting you properly?
lines.style: Attentive, practical warmth. The voice of a mother checking in on small comforts. Slight questioning lift at the end. Genuine care underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの、本気で、絶対、ネクタイ、絶対、お洒落だよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's tie today looks really nice and stylish.
lines.style: Bright observation, proud of noticing. The small sincerity of a child pointing out something good. Quick, genuine. No performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママの、本気で、絶対、香水、絶対、新しいの、絶対、つけてみたわ
lines.en: Sho, I tried on a new perfume today — do you notice it?
lines.style: Tender, almost intimate. A mother sharing something small about herself with her son. Soft voice, close. Seeking his presence more than his answer.
